findings.rationale: Accepted: the helper backstop equals the seat's --timeout with no margin (SIGTERM then SIGKILL 5 s later, teardown not budget); the engine test asserts argv --timeout and helper timeout_seconds are the same number.

Accepted: no artifact records per-seat timing — panel seat ledger rows and the final_panel row carry the batch started_at/ended_at; per-job timing lives only in the helper stdout (tests + evidence dir), so completion order is unobservable in ledger, receipt or digest; §5 reworded.
